task.title: Confirm new user account is registered correctly
task.shortdesc: After setting up a new Red Hat user account with auto-user registration, the Organization Administrator may want to verify that the user account is registered with the correct organization.

ul.li: Ensure you are logged in to the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console as as a user who has Organization Administrator permissions.

step.cmd: Navigate to Hybrid Cloud Console > Settings > User access > Users.
Review the list of your organization’s users.

ul.li: If the new user’s Red Hat account information appears in the list, the new user account has been registered with your organization’s account successfully.
